title: [Subcontracting] Fixed purchase order not opening the list of transfer orders when > 1 were created
summary: Fixed subcontracting purchase orders to display all created transfer orders in a list instead of opening only the last one when multiple transfer orders are created from different source locations.
key_points: Corrected navigation logic to filter transfer orders by purchase order number instead of individual purchase lines
Multiple transfer orders now open in a filtered list view; single transfer order still opens in card view
Updated transfer order creation report to reference purchase header instead of last processed line
Added regression test for purchase orders with multiple production orders at different locations
quote: Added purchase-order-level transfer order navigation filtered by purchase order number and return status.
